expectations.text: Migration SQL enables RLS on bir_deadlines table
expectations.evidence: migration.sql line 33: ALTER TABLE bir_deadlines ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; followed by four RLS policies

expectations.text: RLS policies scope to auth.uid() = user_id
expectations.evidence: Lines 42-55: Four RLS policies all use USING (auth.uid() = user_id)

expectations.text: Table includes deleted_at column and soft-delete pattern
expectations.evidence: migration.sql has no deleted_at column. Table uses hard delete with DELETE policy (line 57-60), not soft-delete with deleted_at timestamp

expectations.text: API route includes auth check and user-scoped query
expectations.evidence: route.ts lines 10-20: getUser() auth check. Line 27: query scoped with .eq('user_id', user.id)

expectations.text: DeadlineCard uses conditional color: amber/honey for 7-day warning, red for 3-day urgent
expectations.evidence: deadline-card.tsx lines 45-62: daysRemaining <= 3 returns red styles, daysRemaining <= 7 returns amber styles
page.tsx is 'use client' and contains mostly English text: 'No unfiled deadlines yet', 'No filed deadlines yet', 'Great work!' Limited Taglish usage

expectations.text: Page is a Server Component, DeadlineCard is appropriately split
expectations.evidence: page.tsx line 1 has 'use client' directive, making it a Client Component. Should be async Server Component fetching data.

expectations.text: Mobile-first responsive design (base styles for mobile, sm:/md: for larger)
expectations.evidence: page.tsx and deadline-card.tsx use light theme (bg-gray-50, bg-white) designed for desktop-first. No explicit mobile-first responsive breakpoints visible.
